model.title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 2407 State Route 71, Suite 1, in Spring Lake, New Jersey, as the James J. Howard Post Office.
model.meta: Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee, Oversight and Government Reform Committee · Rep. Frank Pallone (D-NJ)

summary.text: The bill would rename a U.S. Postal Service facility in Spring Lake, New Jersey, in honor of James J. Howard.
